title: H35: fanout trusts peer directory URLs as given
description: A peer's /.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory may point notify at any URL. Readings: (a) require the peer's configured origin (scheme, host, port; decision mimid-1wgh.17); (b) use the URLs as given. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18: (b), with the risk documented: a misconfigured or hostile peer can make the hub POST fanout bodies to arbitrary hosts (SSRF-like). Peers are operator-configured (.17), not discovered.
